under the species and set its trait (a name a module declares), its range and its founder values; GaussianMutation mutates it and clamps the result to the range (MUT-20). It stays out of the prompt unless "show in prompt" is on. Give the trait a cost, e.g. a metabolism that grows with it: without one the gene drifts to whichever end helps (09 §5, V-47). Properties Decimals The decimals setting (reference 4). public override int Decimals { get; } Property Value int FounderPool The founder values, each with the origin founder; a number gene has no neutral allele. public override IReadOnlyList<FounderAllele> FounderPool { get; } Property Value IReadOnlyList<FounderAllele> Remarks A founder genome draws each locus uniformly from it, and newcomers below the floor too (POP-03). The World registers the whole pool first, in this order, so founder alleles get the same ids in every run (GENE-21): it must give the same values in the same order every time. The validator reports an empty pool (V-41). Founders The founder values, as set in the Inspector. public IReadOnlyList<float> Founders { get; } Property Value IReadOnlyList<float> Kind Whether this gene's alleles are sentences or numbers (GENE-02). public override AlleleKind Kind { get; } Property Value AlleleKind Max The largest value of the gene's own range; mutants outside the range are refused (MUT-20). public float Max { get; } Property Value float Min The smallest value of the gene's own range; mutants outside the range are refused (MUT-20). public float Min { get; } Property Value float MultiplyDefault True when the value multiplies the trait's default; false when it replaces the trait. public bool MultiplyDefault { get; } Property Value bool ReadByBrain True when the value is written into the prompt (the "show in prompt" setting, off in the reference). public override bool ReadByBrain { get; } Property Value bool Trait The name of the trait this gene sets, e.g. stamina.max. public string Trait { get; } Property Value string Methods Check(AlleleValue) Refuses a value outside the gene's range [Min, Max]. public override string Check(AlleleValue value) Parameters value AlleleValue A value: a founder, or a mutant about to be registered. Returns string Why the value is not allowed (e.g. "13 words (at most 12)"), or null when it is. Remarks The hatch phase checks every mutant with it, whatever operator made it: a refused mutant leaves the inherited allele and is counted as not allowed. Text genes also check their founders with it (V-40). Configure(string, float, float, IEnumerable<float>, bool, string) Sets the gene from code (WorldBuilder, tests). public void Configure(string traitName, float rangeMin, float rangeMax, IEnumerable<float> founderValues, bool multiply = false, string geneLabel = null) Parameters traitName string The trait it sets, e.g. stamina.max. rangeMin float The smallest value of the gene's range. rangeMax float The largest value of the gene's range. founderValues IEnumerable<float> The founder values, within the range. multiply bool True: the value multiplies the trait's default. False: it replaces the trait. geneLabel string A label, or null to keep the current one. Express(AlleleValue, Expression) Sets the trait (or multiplies its default) and, when shown in the prompt, writes the value with at most 2 decimals. public override void Express(AlleleValue value, Expression e) Parameters value AlleleValue The allele's value. e Expression The target: call SetTrait(string, float, bool) for a trait, PromptGene(string, string) for a line of the genes block. Remarks Called at birth with the newborn (prompt lines are then dropped), and each time a decision's genes block is written, with no animal (traits are then dropped), for the genes the brain reads. Act only through e. Initialize() Forgets the cached founder pool, so that changes made in the Inspector are seen. public override void Initialize() Remarks Find things by role or name (ARCH-08): Species.Module<Energy>(), World.Service<Ground>(), Species.Declarations.FindTrait("vision"). Reset your own state here: the same object starts every run. SetDecimals(int) Sets the decimals the registry compares (GENE-10), from code. public void SetDecimals(int d) Parameters d int The number of decimals, clamped to [0, 8]. Validate(ValidationReport) Reports a trait no module declares (V-45), founder values outside the range (V-46), an empty founder pool (V-41) and a trait no cost depends on (V-47). public override void Validate(ValidationReport report) Parameters report ValidationReport Add one message per problem, naming its validator id (V-…) and the object at fault. An error stops the run from starting. Remarks Called after every Initialize and after the food web is derived; only read, never change the scene.

api/EvoSim.Observation.html.summary: Class Observation Namespace EvoSim Assembly EvoSim.Runtime.dll The tuple of an animal's sense tokens at one decision, in sense order (SENSE-02). public sealed class Observation : IEquatable<Observation> Inheritance object Observation Implements IEquatable<Observation> Inherited Members object.Equals(object, object) object.GetType() object.ReferenceEquals(object, object) Remarks Entry k is the token index the species' k-th sense returned (Index); the species turns it into the situation text with Describe(Observation, TextStyle). Two observations are equal when their tuples are equal: positions, ids and anything else the senses did not report are not part of it. It is the part of the memo key that changes from decision to decision (DEC-30), so a species with few possible observations gets many memo hits. Read a token by sense label with ObservationView. api/EvoSim.ObservationSet.html.summary: Class ObservationSet Namespace EvoSim Assembly EvoSim.Runtime.dll A fixed list of situations, written by sense label and token (15 §2, "the 48 situations"): the prototype's rows ({"energy": "low", "food": "close", "animal": "adjacent", "animal_ready": true, …}) are matched to a species' senses by label; a sense the row doesn't name takes a default token. public sealed class ObservationSet Inheritance object ObservationSet Inherited Members object.Equals(object) object.Equals(object, object) object.GetHashCode() object.GetType() object.ReferenceEquals(object, object) object.ToString() Remarks The brain integrity gates and tests use it to ask a brain about the same situations whatever the species' sense order: FromJsonLines(string) or PredatorReference() gives the rows, For(Species) turns them into observations of one species. For(Species) Gives every row as an observation of the species. public List<Observation> For(Species species) Parameters species Species The species whose senses read the rows. FromJsonLines(string) Reads JSON lines in the prototype's format (prototype/data/observations_v2.jsonl, copied to Assets/EvoSim/Data/Observations/prey_observations_v2.jsonl). public static ObservationSet FromJsonLines(string text) Parameters text string One JSON object per line. Keys are used as written, so write them in lower case. Returns ObservationSet The set, one row per non-empty line. PredatorReference() Builds the predator's 48 reference situations (15 §2): energy × prey band × carcass × another predator, with the tags the brain checks use (any, prey_present, carcass_present, animal_present, animal_near). public static ObservationSet PredatorReference() Returns ObservationSet A new set of 48 rows (3 energies × 4 prey bands × 2 carcass × 2 other predator), stamina "medium". Returns Observation The observation, or null if a token is unknown to its sense (the species can't express the row).

api/EvoSim.Pending.html.summary: Class Pending Namespace EvoSim Assembly EvoSim.Runtime.dll Work a phase waits for: brain answers, mutations (TICK-03, SPACE-13). public abstract class Pending Inheritance object Pending Derived ManualPending AdvancePending Inherited Members object.Equals(object) object.Equals(object, object) object.GetHashCode() object.GetType() object.MemberwiseClone() object.ReferenceEquals(object, object) object.ToString() Examples public override Pending WaitsFor(TickContext t) => Pending.Of(requestTask); // done when the task completes Remarks A phase returns one from WaitsFor(TickContext). The World reads IsDone on the main thread: in Responsive mode it comes back on a later frame while the work is not done; in Freeze mode it calls Wait(), which blocks until it is (SPACE-14). Build one with Done(), Of(Task) (a Task), All(IReadOnlyList<Pending>) (several), or ManualPending. A subclass must make IsDone safe to read from the main thread while the work runs on another, and Wait must never need the main thread to finish (it is blocked). Properties IsDone True once every answer is in. public abstract bool IsDone { get; } Property Value bool Methods All(IReadOnlyList<Pending>) Done when all of them are done; null entries count as done. public static Pending All(IReadOnlyList<Pending> parts) Parameters parts IReadOnlyList<Pending> The parts to wait for. Returns Pending Null when there is no part (nothing to wait for), the part itself when there is one, else a pending done when every part is. Done() A pending that is already done. public static Pending Done() Returns Pending A new pending whose IsDone is always true. api/EvoSim.PromptWriter.html.title: Class PromptWriter | EvoSim
api/EvoSim.PromptWriter.html.summary: Class PromptWriter Namespace EvoSim Assembly EvoSim.Runtime.dll Collects the action lines and rule lines that modules contribute to a species' prompt (PROMPT-01). Numbers in rule lines come from placeholders filled from module settings (PROMPT-03): {field} on the writing module, {Module.field} on another module of the species, {species.Module.field} on a module of another species; {name} and {species.name} are display names. A placeholder reads a field or a property; {{ and }} write a brace. A module is named by its class, a base class, or its GameObject. public sealed class PromptWriter Inheritance object PromptWriter Inherited Members object.Equals(object) object.Equals(object, object) object.GetHashCode() object.GetType() object.ReferenceEquals(object, object) object.ToString() Examples A module writes its Inspector text as a rule; the reference prey locomotion's text begins "Animals move {walkSpeed} meter per step. Predators run {predator.Locomotion.runSpeed} meters per step when they hunt," and goes on with "{predator.Stamina.max} stamina against an animal's {Stamina.max}". The sample Thirst writes its number itself: public override void WritePromptRules(PromptWriter w) => w.Rule($"Thirst grows every step; an animal dies of thirst at {Bands.Number(deadly)}. Drinking resets it."); Remarks Build(Species) makes one writer per species when the run starts, and hands it to every module's WritePromptRules(PromptWriter) in hierarchy order (so action lines come in action order), then to every world service's WritePromptRules(Species, PromptWriter). A module calls Action(string, string) or Rule(string); it writes nothing else. Placeholders keep the prompt true to the world: change a speed in the Inspector and the prompt says the new number (PROMPT-03). The species' header and genes intro, and a frozen prompt, are filled with no writing module: there only {name} and the qualified forms work. {genes}, {situation} and {ask} are left for Fill(string, string, string). An unknown placeholder stays in the text and is reported (V-53). Constructors PromptWriter(Species) Makes an empty writer for a species. Build(Species) makes one; tools and tests may too. public PromptWriter(Species species) Parameters species Species The species whose prompt is written. Properties ActionLines The action lines written so far, "- eat: go to the nearest visible food and eat it". public IReadOnlyList<string> ActionLines { get; } Property Value IReadOnlyList<string> Current The module writing now: {field} placeholders read it. public object Current { get; } Property Value object Problems Unknown placeholders found while writing (V-53). public IReadOnlyList<string> Problems { get; } Property Value IReadOnlyList<string> RuleLines The rule lines written so far, placeholders filled. public IReadOnlyList<string> RuleLines { get; } Property Value IReadOnlyList<string> Species The species whose prompt is being written: {name} is its display name, {Module.field} reads its modules. public Species Species { get; } Property Value Species Methods Action(string, string) Adds one line of the action list: "- name: description" (PROMPT-01). public void Action(string name, string description) Parameters name string The action's name, as the brain reads it ("eat"). description string What the action does, from its Inspector text; its placeholders are filled. Remarks Every action writes its own line (AnimalAction.WritePromptRules); other modules write rules. Build(Species) The species' prompt template (PROMPT-01): header, actions, rules from its modules and from world services, the genes intro and {genes}, the situation and {ask}; or its frozen prompt (PROMPT-04). public static PromptTemplate Build(Species s) Parameters s Species The species, its modules discovered. Returns PromptTemplate The template and the problems found (unknown placeholders, holes missing from a frozen prompt). Remarks Called by the World for each species when the run starts and when a species is added (SPEC-30), and by RebuildPrompt(). With a frozen prompt the modules still write, so their problems are reported, but only the frozen text is used. Fill(string) Fills {placeholders} from module settings; unknown ones are kept and reported. public string Fill(string text) Parameters text string A text with placeholders, or null. Returns string The text with each placeholder replaced by the value it names, "{{" and "}}" by single braces; {genes}, {situation}, {ask} and unknown placeholders unchanged. OverlayRule(Species) The engine's rule line for a species with overlays (ACT-07, PROMPT-03): "Some actions are done in passing (alarm): the animal also does its next most likely choice."; null when the species has none. public static string OverlayRule(Species s) Parameters s Species The species, its actions found. Returns string The line, the overlays named in action order, or null. Rule(string) Adds one rule line, its placeholders filled. public void Rule(string line) Parameters line string The rule, usually a module's Inspector text; it may hold several lines. Null, empty or blank adds nothing, so a module with an empty rule text writes nothing. TryRead(object, string, out string) Reads a field, else a property (public or private, of the class or a base class), formatted as the brain reads it. public static bool TryRead(object target, string field, out string value) Parameters target object The module or object to read. field string The field's or property's name, exactly as in the code ("runSpeed", "max"). value string The value as text: numbers as Number(float) writes them, booleans "yes" / "no"; null when not found. of teaching-path exercise 13 (MyRandomBrain, 22 §0). What it does: its Id is "random"; Ask(IReadOnlyList<DecisionQuery>) makes one row per query, in query order, with one entry per action of that query's species, each 1/n (Uniform(int)), and answers at once with Now(float[][]). It reads neither the genes nor the situation, and keeps every default (memoizable, any number of actions, species mixed in one batch, no cache). api/EvoSim.RandomStream.html.summary: Class RandomStream Namespace EvoSim Assembly EvoSim.Runtime.dll One named random stream: a PCG32 generator seeded from SHA-256 of the seed and the name (RAND-02). public sealed class RandomStream Inheritance object RandomStream Inherited Members object.Equals(object) object.Equals(object, object) object.GetHashCode() object.GetType() object.ReferenceEquals(object, object) object.ToString() Examples var rng = t.Stream(a.Species, "actions"); // "<species id>/actions" float angle = rng.Range(0f, 360f); // degrees if (rng.Chance(0.3)) { /* ... */ } // true 30 % of the time int pick = rng.Range(0, candidates.Count); // an index Remarks Never make one yourself in simulation code: ask the World's streams for it (Stream(Species, string), For(Species, string)), so the same seed and name always give the same numbers, and draws in one stream never shift another's (RAND-02). Never use UnityEngine.Random or an unseeded System.Random (RAND-01). Each method's number of draws is fixed, except Range(int, int), which redraws to avoid bias, and Chance(double), which draws nothing for a probability of 0 or 1. a 4 m grid that each hold one berry and grow it back (the shape of FoodGrid, cut down). public class BerryBushes : ResourceLayer { [SerializeField] float regrowP = 0.01f; CellGrid grid; bool[] berries; int count; public override int Count => count; public override void Initialize() { grid = new CellGrid(World.Ground.Bounds, 4f); berries = new bool[grid.Count]; count = 0; } public override bool Nearest(Vector3 p, float radius, out ResourceItem item) { int c = grid.Nearest(berries, p, radius, World.Ground, out float d); item = c >= 0 ? new ResourceItem(this, c, World.Ground.OnGround(grid.Center(c)), d) : default; return c >= 0; } public override bool Consume(ResourceItem item) { if (item.Layer != this || item.Cell < 0 || !berries[item.Cell]) return false; // gone already (ENV-02) berries[item.Cell] = false; count--; return true; } public override void Regrow(RandomStream rng) { for (int c = 0; c < grid.Count; c++) if (!berries[c] && rng.NextDouble() < regrowP) { berries[c] = true; count++; } } } Remarks Derive from it, implement Count, Nearest(Vector3, float, out ResourceItem) and Consume(ResourceItem), override Regrow(RandomStream) if the layer grows back, and place the component under the World (reference: "Grass" under Environment) with an Edible. Give the GameObject a unique name: it is the layer's name in diets, senses and random streams, and must not be "world", "act-order" or contain "/" (V-18). Lifecycle: Initialize() runs after the ground's (build empty storage there); Begin() runs once every module is ready, cover included (place the first items there, with the stream "world/<layer name>"); Regrow(RandomStream) runs once per tick in the environment phase. Rules to keep: consuming removes the item at once, so two animals never eat the same one (ENV-02); the layer changes only in Regrow(RandomStream) and Consume(ResourceItem), and draws random numbers only from the stream it is given (ENV-03); ties in Nearest(Vector3, float, out ResourceItem) are broken by a fixed key (SPACE-08). Properties Count How many items the layer holds (ENV-01). public abstract int Count { get; } Property Value int Edible The layer's edible component (SPEC-10), or null: then nothing can eat it. public Edible Edible { get; } Property Value Edible LayerName The name diets and senses use (ARCH-08). public string LayerName { get; } Property Value string StreamName The name of the layer's regrowth stream (RAND-03): the layer's name. public virtual string StreamName { get; } Property Value string Methods Consume(ResourceItem) Removes the item at once; false if it was already gone (ENV-02). public abstract bool Consume(ResourceItem item) Parameters item ResourceItem An item this layer returned from Nearest(Vector3, float, out ResourceItem), this tick. Returns bool True when the item was there and is now eaten; false when it was gone or belongs to another layer. Remarks Called by the interaction resolver when an animal grazes; the act order decides who eats a contested item. Nearest(Vector3, float, out ResourceItem) The nearest item within radius of a point (ENV-01, SPACE-07); false if none. public abstract bool Nearest(Vector3 p, float radius, out ResourceItem item) Parameters p Vector3 The point searched from, usually an animal's position. radius float The largest distance, in meters (inclusive). item ResourceItem The nearest item, or default when none is found. Returns bool True when an item was found within the radius. Remarks Measure with the world's distance (Distance(Vector3, Vector3), SPACE-02), and break ties by a fixed key (SPACE-08). Regrow(RandomStream) Regrowth, once per tick in the environment phase, with the layer's own stream (ENV-03). public virtual void Regrow(RandomStream rng) Parameters rng RandomStream The layer's stream, named StreamName; draw only from it, in a fixed order. Remarks Does nothing by default: a layer that never grows back. FindObjectsInactive) Object.ToString() Object.name Object.hideFlags object.Equals(object, object) object.GetType() object.MemberwiseClone() object.ReferenceEquals(object, object) Remarks Place it under the World's Recording object, with a RecordPhase among the phases (V-09). In Begin(), after every module is ready and before the founders, it opens a new folder under OutputRoot (OUT-01), listens to Events, and writes the stats header and run_info.json. The record phase then calls WriteStats(int) and AfterTick(int); when the run stops, OnRunStopped(string) writes alleles.jsonl, final_population.json, summary.json and run_info.json again. stats.csv columns: t; then per species, with the prefix <species>_, pop, mean_energy, mean_stamina, exhausted, mean_gen, max_gen, births, immigrants, the deaths_… columns, decisions, backend_queries, invalid, portions, one act_<action> per action and its modules' IStatsColumns; alleles after the first species; then the World modules' columns. Counts are cumulative. The events hash is always computed on the canonical line, so the compatibility mode changes the files, never the hash. The summary's events_hash and events_sha (its first 16 hex digits) identify the run. Properties Compatibility True to write a two-species world as the prototype does (OUT-05), for its analysis tools. public bool Compatibility { get; set; } Property Value bool ExtraInfo Extra entries for run_info.json (the scenario, its overrides), set before the run. public SortedDictionary<string, object> ExtraInfo { get; } Property Value SortedDictionary<string, object> OutputRoot The folder that receives one sub-folder per run, relative to the project (in a player: to its folder). public string OutputRoot { get; set; } Property Value string RunFolder The full path of this run's folder, or null before Begin() or when files are off. public string RunFolder { get; } Property Value string RunName The run folder's name; empty = <world>-s<seed>-<date>. {world} and {seed} are replaced. public string RunName { get; set; } Property Value string StatsEvery A statistics row every this many ticks (reference 100). public int StatsEvery { get; } Property Value int WriteFiles True to write files; false keeps only the hash and the counters (tests). public bool WriteFiles { get; set; } Property Value bool Methods AfterTick(int) Called by the record phase every tick: flushes events and stats, and the allele list, on their periods. public void AfterTick(int tick) Parameters tick int The number of ticks done (the record phase passes its tick + 1). Begin() After everything is ready, before founders: open the folder and the files. public override void Begin() Remarks A folder that exists already gets a suffix (-2, -3…), so a run never writes into another's (OUT-01). CompatId(string) In the compatibility mode the first species' loci have no prefix: "prey.eat:3" → "eat:3" (OUT-05). public string CompatId(string id) Parameters id string An allele or locus id, or null. Returns string The id without the first species' prefix in the compatibility mode; otherwise unchanged. Configure(string, string, bool, bool, int) Sets the recorder from code (WorldBuilder, batch runs, tests), before the World initialises. public void Configure(string root, string name, bool compat = false, bool files = true, int statsInterval = 100) Parameters root string The folder that receives the run folders, relative to the project. name string The run folder's name; empty = <world>-s<seed>-<date>. compat bool True for the prototype's formats (OUT-05). files bool False to write no file (hash and counters only). statsInterval int A statistics row every this many ticks (at least 1). Initialize() Closes any file left open and forgets the previous run's folder and rows. public override void Initialize() Remarks Look up what you need here, by role or name (Service<T>(), Phase<T>()), and reset your own state: the same object starts every run of the World. A service is initialised before the species' modules; a phase after them. OnEvent(SimEvent, string) Writes the event's line to events.jsonl, in the prototype's form in the compatibility mode. public void OnEvent(SimEvent e, string line) Parameters e SimEvent The event, with its kind, tick, id, species and fields. line string Its canonical JSON line, as hashed and as written to events.jsonl (outside the compatibility mode). OnRunStopped(string) Writes the final files (alleles, final population, summary with the stop reason, run info) and closes the run's files; only once. public override void OnRunStopped(string reason) Parameters reason string Why it stopped, as StopReason says: "tick limit", "stop file", "world disabled"… Remarks Write and close your files here (the run recorder does). An exception is logged and the other modules still hear the stop. WriteStats(int) One statistics row; the record phase calls it every statsEvery ticks. public void WriteStats(int tick) Parameters tick int The row's t: the number of ticks done. Remarks When the columns changed since the last row (a species added, a new death cause or module column), the file is rewritten with the new header first; older rows get empty cells in the new columns.

api/EvoSim.RunState.html.title: Enum RunState | EvoSim
api/EvoSim.RunState.html.summary: Enum RunState Namespace EvoSim Assembly EvoSim.Runtime.dll The World's run loop states (brief, chapter B §13). public enum RunState Fields Idle = 0 Not initialised. Running = 1 Ticks advance every FixedUpdate (or per the run speed). Waiting = 2 Inside a tick, waiting for answers while Unity renders (Responsive). Blocked = 3 Inside a tick, the main thread blocked on answers (Freeze). Paused = 4 Between ticks or inside one; nothing advances. Stepping = 5 One tick, then Paused. Stopped = 6 At a tick boundary, every output written (RAND-20). Remarks Read it from State; the run controls (Play(), Pause(), Step()…) change it.

A sense labelled "Chased" with two tokens, "no" and "yes": yes when the nearest threat in sight is doing an action that hunts (Hunts) and its target is this animal. V2 texts: "Something is chasing me." / "Nothing is chasing me.". Mechanism. A plain Sense: fixed Tokens, a Read(Animal, SenseContext) that only asks the SenseContext (the nearest threat, and CurrentTarget(Animal), read from the state at the start of the tick), and its own Write(int, TextStyle) for the V2 sentences. In a scene. Add it on a new child GameObject among the species' senses. It doubles the observation space; it only says yes when the species has threats (a predator, or itself for a cannibal). Properties DefaultLabel "Chased". protected override string DefaultLabel { get; } Property Value string Tokens "no" and "yes". public override IReadOnlyList<string> Tokens { get; } Property Value IReadOnlyList<string> Methods Read(Animal, SenseContext) "yes" when the nearest threat within vision hunts and targets this animal, else "no" (also when no threat is in sight). public override int Read(Animal a, SenseContext s) Parameters a Animal The animal that decides. s SenseContext The world as it was at the start of the tick: nearest animals, food, cover, distances, rays. Returns int An index into Tokens. Remarks Called by the sense phase, through ReadAll(IReadOnlyList<Animal>, SenseContext, Span<int>), for every animal that decides this tick, and by tools (Observe(Animal, SenseContext)). It must give the same token for the same state, draw no random number, change nothing in the world, and learn about other animals only through s, which leaves out hidden and killed ones (SENSE-03, SENSE-06). Write(int, TextStyle) V2: "Something is chasing me." or "Nothing is chasing me."; V1: "Chased: yes." or "Chased: no.". public override string Write(int token, TextStyle style) Parameters token int An index into Tokens. style TextStyle The world's text style: V1 terse ("Energy: low."), or V2 first person ("I am hungry and weak.") (SENSE-11). Returns string A sentence ending with a period. The default writes "Label: token." in both styles. Remarks The species joins the fragments of its senses with spaces (Describe(Observation, TextStyle)). The text depends on the token only, never on the animal, so the same observation always gives the same text: the answer cache keys on it. Override it for V2 sentences or to state a range in meters (SENSE-12, SENSE-13).

A cause of death, "thirst", and the growth of the Thirst stat: every tick, in the death phase, each animal's thirst grows by PerTick; at Deadly the animal dies. One small rule does both jobs, so thirst ages with the animal. Mechanism. A DeathRule: Causes names its causes (one statistics column each) and CauseOfDeath(Animal) returns a cause or null. [RequiresModule(typeof(Thirst))] names the module it needs: validation offers to add it, and the conformance suites add it before testing. In a scene. Add it on a child GameObject of the species, with a Thirst. Initialize() Finds the species' Thirst module. public override void Initialize() Validate(ValidationReport) Reports an error (V-20) when the species has no Thirst module. public override void Validate(ValidationReport report) Parameters report ValidationReport Add one message per problem, naming its validator id (V-…) and the object at fault. An action, "drag", for a species that eats carcasses: it fetches the nearest carcass it may eat from and carries it, at walking speed, into the nearest cover in sight, where hunters can't see it. No carcass in sight: it searches; no cover in sight: it stays by the carcass. Mechanism. An AnimalAction with a custom IInteraction that changes an entity: an entity's position may change, but only in a phase (ENV-21). The interaction's reach is unlimited, so it applies every tick after the animal moved. It is not one of the recipes of 22: it writes out the S18 scenario of 31. In a scene. Add it on a new GameObject named "drag" under the actions of a species whose diet lists carcasses (the predator), with a TextGene on the same GameObject. IsRelevant(ObservationView) reads the "Carcass" sense. Properties DefaultDescription "drag the nearest carcass toward cover". protected override string DefaultDescription { get; } Property Value string Methods Act(Animal, ActContext) No carcass in sight: searches (ACT-04). Farther than the grab reach: walks to it. Within reach: walks toward the nearest cover in sight and drags the carcass along (stays when no cover is in sight). public override void Act(Animal a, ActContext c) Parameters a Animal The animal that acts: alive and not busy. c ActContext The context to query and plan through; Begin(Animal) was already called for a. Remarks Called by the act phase, through ActAll(IReadOnlyList<Animal>, ActContext, Span<ActPlan>), once per tick for each animal that chose this action. Look the target up again each tick, so that a moving target is followed (ACT-02). The plan is the last intent and the last interaction the method set; doing nothing means stay. IsRelevant(ObservationView) True when the "Carcass" sense reports a carcass in sight (CTRL-10); false without that sense. public override bool IsRelevant(ObservationView o) Parameters o ObservationView An observation of this species, read by sense label with Token(string). Returns bool True when the action would have something to act on in that situation.

An action the brain can choose, "drink": the animal walks to the shore of the nearest water in sight and its Thirst drops to 0 on arrival. No water in sight: it searches (ACT-04). Mechanism. An AnimalAction that only gives an intent (walk to the shore) and an interaction on arrival: a custom IInteraction, applied by the act phase within its reach (ACT-10). Add it on a new GameObject named "drink" under the species' actions, with a TextGene on the same GameObject whose founders say when to drink ("Drink whenever you pass water.", "Drink only when very thirsty."). A mutation of text genes without a language model: "Rest often when tired." becomes "Rest always when tired." or "Rest sometimes when tired.", keeping the word's capital and punctuation. A sentence without an intensity word fails the job ("no intensity word"), and the gene stays as it was. Mechanism. A MutationOperator: Accepts(Gene) says which genes it can change, and StartMutation(Gene, Allele, RandomStream) draws its random choice from the stream it is given and returns a finished job. It is blind (CORE-07): it never reads the world or other genes. The usual guards still check its result. In a scene. Add it under the species' Mutation object and list in its onlyThese the genes it applies to; the other text genes keep the species' default operator (MUT-02). Methods Accepts(Gene) Text genes only. public override bool Accepts(Gene g) Parameters g Gene A gene of the species. Returns bool True when it can mutate this gene's alleles. Remarks Asked at each conception for each locus (MUT-02) and by the validator, which warns about a gene no operator accepts (V-48). StartMutation(Gene, Allele, RandomStream) Finds the sentence's first intensity word and moves it one step up or down the ladder (one coin flip from rng), clamped at both ends; fails when the sentence has none. public override MutationJob StartMutation(Gene g, Allele parent, RandomStream rng) Parameters g Gene The gene being mutated (not read). parent Allele The allele to change; its text is read. rng RandomStream The mutation stream: the only source of randomness (MUT-30). Returns MutationJob A finished job: the new sentence with the detail "ladder+1" or "ladder-1", or a failure.

A sense labelled "Water" whose tokens are here, one per distance band, and none: "Water: 1-4 meters away." in V1, "I am at the water's edge." when within 0.5 m of the water. Only a ground that knows water answers (NearestWater(Vector3, float): the terrain ground, or a test's pond); on a flat ground it always says none. Mechanism. In a scene. Add it on a new child GameObject among the species' senses: its place among them is its place in the situation text. It multiplies the observation space by its number of tokens (6 with the reference bands). Properties DefaultLabel "Water". protected override string DefaultLabel { get; } Property Value string HasHere True: this sense has a "here" token, for an animal at the shore. protected override bool HasHere { get; } Property Value bool Methods HereSentence() "I am at the water's edge." protected override string HereSentence() Returns string "I am standing on food." by default (with Noun); "I am in cover." for the cover sense. Returns int An index into Tokens. Remarks Called by the sense phase, through ReadAll(IReadOnlyList<Animal>, SenseContext, Span<int>), for every animal that decides this tick, and by tools (Observe(Animal, SenseContext)). It must give the same token for the same state, draw no random number, change nothing in the world, and learn about other animals only through s, which leaves out hidden and killed ones (SENSE-03, SENSE-06).

A species that avoids steep slopes and pays to climb: on the same terrain, a species with it and a kinematic one move differently. Mechanism. A subclass of a reference module (MOVE-07): it overrides Move(Animal, Intent, float, MoveContext) to change the intent (stay when the step ahead is too steep) and then lets KinematicLocomotion do the moving, and overrides ExtraCost(Animal, Vector3, Vector3), which the metabolism adds to the energy of the move (MOVE-06). In a scene. Replace the species' KinematicLocomotion component by this one: a species has exactly one locomotion (V-13). It matters only on a ground with heights (the terrain ground). Properties EnergyPerMeterClimbed The energy one meter of climbing costs, in points per meter of height gained. public float EnergyPerMeterClimbed { get; } Property Value float MaxSlopeDegrees The steepest slope the animal walks onto, in degrees. public float MaxSlopeDegrees { get; } Property Value float Methods Configure(float, float) Sets the locomotion from code (tests). public void Configure(float maxDegrees, float perMeterClimbed) Parameters maxDegrees float The steepest slope allowed, in degrees. perMeterClimbed float The energy per meter climbed, in points. ExtraCost(Animal, Vector3, Vector3) The height gained times EnergyPerMeterClimbed; going down or on the flat costs nothing extra. public override float ExtraCost(Animal a, Vector3 from, Vector3 to) Parameters a Animal The animal that moved. from Vector3 Where it was before moving. to Vector3 Where it is after moving. Returns float Energy points to pay, 0 or more; a negative value counts as 0. Remarks The act phase calls it after the animal moved more than 1 mm and passes it to Settle(Animal, float, float, bool), which pays it on top of the tick's cost (ANIM-20). Move(Animal, Intent, float, MoveContext) Looks at the slope from the animal to one meter ahead along the intent; steeper than the limit, the animal stays. Otherwise it moves as the kinematic locomotion does. public override float Move(Animal a, Intent intent, float staminaBudget, MoveContext c) Parameters a Animal The animal to move: set its Position. intent Intent What its action wants: direction, walk or run, maximum distance. The act phase only passes intents that move, but return 0 for a stay all the same. staminaBudget float The most it may move this tick, in meters (ANIM-21); infinity without a stamina module. c MoveContext The ground, the world distance and the random streams. Returns float The meters actually moved, measured with Distance(Vector3, Vector3); 0 when the animal didn't move.

A stat thirst on every animal of the species, from 0 (at birth) to Deadly, and a rule line in the prompt. Thirst itself only declares and describes the stat: it grows, and kills, through DiesOfThirst, and DrinkAction sets it back to 0. Mechanism. A SpeciesModule that declares a stat in Declare(SpeciesBuilder) and writes a prompt rule in WritePromptRules(PromptWriter). Other modules find it with Species.Module<Thirst>() and read the stat through Value; a LevelSense with stat "thirst" lets the brain sense it, with no code. In a scene. Add it as a component on a new child GameObject of the species (next to its other stats), with a DiesOfThirst. Checklist of 22 §1: the cause "thirst" appears in death events and in stats.csv (deaths_thirst). Properties Deadly The thirst at which an animal dies, in points: also the stat's maximum. public float Deadly { get; } Property Value float PerTick The thirst added every tick, in points. public float PerTick { get; } Property Value float Value The thirst stat: read and write it with a[thirst.Value]. public StatId Value { get; } Property Value StatId Methods Configure(float, float) Sets the module from code (tests). public void Configure(float growth, float lethal) Parameters growth float The thirst added every tick, in points. lethal float The thirst at which an animal dies, in points. Declare(SpeciesBuilder) Declares the stat thirst: 0 at birth, kept in [0, Deadly]. public override void Declare(SpeciesBuilder b) Parameters b SpeciesBuilder The species' declarations: call DeclareStat(string, StatStart, float, float, TraitId) and DeclareTrait(string, float, float, float, bool), and keep the ids they return. Remarks Called before any module's Initialize: don't look up other modules here. Two modules may declare the same name: they get the same id, and the first declaration counts (V-38 if they differ). WritePromptRules(PromptWriter) Adds the rule line "Thirst grows every step; an animal dies of thirst at 100. Drinking resets it.", with the number taken from Deadly (PROMPT-03). public override void WritePromptRules(PromptWriter w) Parameters w PromptWriter The species' prompt writer: add a line with w.Rule("…"). Remarks Called while the species' prompt template is built, in module order. The lines go into the prompt's id, its cache keys and the species' results, so keep them stable.

api/EvoSim.Samples.html.summary: Namespace EvoSim.Samples Classes ChasedSense Recipe 22 §13: whether the nearest threat is hunting this animal — its target at the start of the tick (SENSE-04). Lets a cannibal tell a hungry neighbour from a peaceful one. DiesOfThirst Recipe 22 §1: thirst grows in the death phase, and an animal at the deadly level dies of "thirst". DragAction Scenario S18 (ENV-21): walk to the nearest carcass in sight, then drag it 1 m per tick toward the nearest cover. The carcass moves in the act phase through an interaction, never from the visuals. DrinkAction Recipe 22 §3: walk to the nearest visible water's shore and drink there, which resets thirst. IntensityLadder Recipe 22 §8 (MUT-21): a rule-based text operator that moves the sentence's intensity word one step along never, rarely, sometimes, often, always — no model. It sees only the gene and its stream (MUT-30). NearestWaterSense Recipe 22 §2: how far the nearest water is, in bands, with "here" at the shore (a query the ground offers). SeasonsPhase Recipe 22 §9: a phase before Environment that slows the grass's regrowth in the second half of every year. SlopeLocomotion Recipe 22 §14: the kinematic locomotion that refuses ground steeper than a limit and charges energy for every meter climbed (MOVE-02 still holds: it only moves the animal through Move). Thirst Recipe 22 §1: a thirst stat that grows every tick (with DiesOfThirst) and kills at a threshold.

ChasedSense (22 §13): whether the nearest threat is hunting this animal. public class ChasedSense : Sense { static readonly IReadOnlyList<string> tokens = System.Array.AsReadOnly(new[] { "no", "yes" }); public override IReadOnlyList<string> Tokens => tokens; protected override string DefaultLabel => "Chased"; public override int Read(Animal a, SenseContext s) { var threat = s.NearestAnimal(a, AnimalSet.Threats, s.Vision(a)); if (threat == null) return 0; var t = threat.Value.Animal; bool hunting = t.CurrentAction != null && t.CurrentAction.Hunts; return hunting && s.CurrentTarget(t) == a ? 1 : 0; } public override string Write(int token, TextStyle style) => style == TextStyle.V2 ? (token == 1 ? "Something is chasing me." : "Nothing is chasing me.") : $"{Label}: {tokens[token]}."; } Remarks Derive from it, list every token in Tokens, implement Read(Animal, SenseContext), and place the component under a species. The species collects its senses depth-first in its hierarchy: that order (Index) is the order of the tokens in the Observation and of the fragments in the situation text (SENSE-02, SENSE-10). Lifecycle: Declare(SpeciesBuilder) declares the traits the sense reads (such as "vision"); Initialize() finds stats and other modules and builds the token list; then, on every tick with decisions, the sense phase calls ReadAll(IReadOnlyList<Animal>, SenseContext, Span<int>) for the deciding animals of the species, and the species calls Write(int, TextStyle) to turn each token into text. A sense only reads. It sees the world as it was at the start of the tick (SENSE-04), asks through SenseContext so hidden and killed animals are never reported (SENSE-06), and draws no random number: the same state gives the same token (SENSE-03). It keeps settings only, nothing per animal. Each sense multiplies the species' number of possible observations by its token count (SENSE-05): few tokens keep the memo and the answer cache useful. Fields label The label typed in the Inspector, or empty for DefaultLabel. Read it through Label. [SerializeField] [Tooltip("The sense's label in the situation text (SENSE-10, SPEC-20). Empty = the sense's default.")] protected string label Field Value string Properties DefaultLabel The label when the Inspector leaves it empty: by default the class name without "Sense" ("AgeSense" gives "Age"). Reference senses override it with their reference label ("Food", "Predator", "Carcass"…). protected virtual string DefaultLabel { get; } Property Value string HasAttachments True when this sense can give attachments (SENSE-41): the ask-brains phase then calls Attachment(Animal, SenseContext), and validation checks that the species' brain accepts them (V-51). False by default. public virtual bool HasAttachments { get; } Property Value bool Index This sense's place in the species' sense order (0 for the first), which is its place in every observation; -1 until the species collects its modules at set-up. public int Index { get; } Property Value int Label The sense's name in the situation text ("Food: here.") and in Token(string): the Inspector's label, or DefaultLabel when it is empty (SENSE-10, SPEC-20). public string Label { get; } Property Value string Tokens Every token this sense can return, "none" included, in a fixed order: Read(Animal, SenseContext) returns an index into this list. Fixed before the run (SENSE-01); its length is the sense's factor in the observation space (SENSE-05). public abstract IReadOnlyList<string> Tokens { get; } Property Value IReadOnlyList<string> Remarks Build it in a field or in Initialize(), never during a run. A static list shared by every instance should be read-only. Methods Attachment(Animal, SenseContext) Gives an attachment for this animal at this decision, such as a small camera image (SENSE-40). public virtual object Attachment(Animal a, SenseContext s) Parameters a Animal The animal that decides. s SenseContext This tick's sense context. Returns object The attachment, or null for none (the default). Remarks Called by the ask-brains phase while it builds the query, only when HasAttachments is true. The attachment travels in Attachments; only a brain whose AcceptsAttachments is true may read it (V-51). AttachmentKey(object) Gives a short text that stands for an attachment in the memo and cache keys, such as a coarse summary (SENSE-41). public virtual string AttachmentKey(object attachment) Parameters attachment object An attachment this sense gave. Returns string The key, or null (the default): then a query carrying this attachment is never memoised, shared or cached. Read(Animal, SenseContext) Reads one animal at a decision and returns its token (SENSE-03). public abstract int Read(Animal a, SenseContext s) Parameters a Animal The animal that decides. s SenseContext The world as it was at the start of the tick: nearest animals, food, cover, distances, rays. Returns int An index into Tokens. Remarks Called by the sense phase, through ReadAll(IReadOnlyList<Animal>, SenseContext, Span<int>), for every animal that decides this tick, and by tools (Observe(Animal, SenseContext)). It must give the same token for the same state, draw no random number, change nothing in the world, and learn about other animals only through s, which leaves out hidden and killed ones (SENSE-03, SENSE-06). ReadAll(IReadOnlyList<Animal>, SenseContext, Span<int>) Reads every deciding animal of the species in one call: the batch entry point the sense phase uses (20 §10, ARCH-12). The default calls Read(Animal, SenseContext) for each animal. public virtual void ReadAll(IReadOnlyList<Animal> group, SenseContext s, Span<int> tokens) Parameters group IReadOnlyList<Animal> The deciding animals of this species this tick, in id order. s SenseContext This tick's sense context, its rays already cast. tokens Span<int> Where to write the tokens: tokens[i] for group[i]; exactly as long as the group. Remarks Override it only to go faster (a Burst job…). The override must write exactly the tokens Read(Animal, SenseContext) would give, animal by animal (SENSE-31); Read(Animal, SenseContext) stays the readable reference and the test oracle. SetLabel(string) Sets the label from code (WorldBuilder, tests), as the Inspector field does. public void SetLabel(string text) Parameters text string The new label; empty for DefaultLabel. Write(int, TextStyle) Writes a token as the text the brain reads: one fragment of the situation text (SENSE-10). public virtual string Write(int token, TextStyle style) Parameters token int An index into Tokens. style TextStyle The world's text style: V1 terse ("Energy: low."), or V2 first person ("I am hungry and weak.") (SENSE-11). Returns string A sentence ending with a period. The default writes "Label: token." in both styles. Remarks The species joins the fragments of its senses with spaces (Describe(Observation, TextStyle)). The text depends on the token only, never on the animal, so the same observation always gives the same text: the answer cache keys on it. Override it for V2 sentences or to state a range in meters (SENSE-12, SENSE-13).

api/EvoSim.SenseContext.html.title: Class SenseContext | EvoSim
api/EvoSim.SenseContext.html.summary: Class SenseContext Namespace EvoSim Assembly EvoSim.Runtime.dll What a sense may read at a decision: the world state at the start of the tick (SENSE-04), through the same queries as actions, so hidden and killed animals are never reported (SENSE-06). public sealed class SenseContext Inheritance object SenseContext Inherited Members object.Equals(object) object.Equals(object, object) object.GetHashCode() object.GetType() object.ReferenceEquals(object, object) object.ToString() Remarks The sense phase makes one context per world and passes it to every Read(Animal, SenseContext) of the tick; the ask-brains phase reuses it for attachments. It runs first in the tick, so what the context reports is the state before anyone acts. The queries wrap WorldQueries: never the animal itself, never a killed animal, never one hidden in cover from the asking species, diets checked, ties broken by id (SPACE-08). Pass the animal's vision as the radius (Vision(Animal)) so the sense sees what its actions can reach (ACT-05). Constructors SenseContext(World) Makes a context for a world, with an empty ray batch. The sense phase makes one in its Initialize. public SenseContext(World world) Parameters world World The world to sense. Properties GrazeReach Within this distance, in meters, an item counts as "here": the act phase's graze reach, 0.5 m without an act phase. The food sense says "here" within it, because eating needs no walk then. public float GrazeReach { get; } Property Value float Ground The world's ground (terrain heights, walkability, water…), or null when the world has none. public Ground Ground { get; } Property Value Ground Rays The rays of the batched senses, cast once per sense phase by CastRays(IReadOnlyList<Animal>) (SENSE-30). A BatchedSense reads its results with Hit(Animal, Sense, int, out RaycastHit). public RayBatch Rays { get; } Property Value RayBatch Tick The current tick, counted from 0. public int Tick { get; } Property Value int World The world being sensed: its services, species and settings. public World World { get; } Property Value World Methods CastRays(IReadOnlyList<Animal>) Collects the rays of every batched sense for these animals and casts them in one batch (SENSE-30). public void CastRays(IReadOnlyList<Animal> animals) Parameters animals IReadOnlyList<Animal> The animals that decide this tick, of every species. Remarks Called by the sense phase before any sense reads. It clears the previous rays, calls RequestRays(Animal, RayBatch) for each animal and each of its batched senses, then casts them all. A context whose rays were never cast for an animal reports each of its rays as a miss. CurrentTarget(Animal) Gives the animal another animal's action was about at the start of this tick (its target last tick), or null (22 §13, the "chased" sense). public Animal CurrentTarget(Animal other) Parameters other Animal The animal looked at, such as the nearest threat. Returns Animal Its target, which may since have died or been killed, or null when it had none or was busy. Remarks The act phase sets the target; the sense phase runs before it, so this is last tick's target (SENSE-04). It searches every living animal: fine for one sense, slow if called for many animals per tick. InCover(Animal) Tells whether the animal stands in cover, of any cover layer. public bool InCover(Animal a) Parameters a Animal The animal that senses. Returns bool True when it stands in cover; false otherwise, and always without a cover layer. IsReady(Animal) Tells whether another animal is ready to mate, by its species' mating rule (REPRO-01). public bool IsReady(Animal other) Parameters other Animal The animal looked at, usually one found by NearestAnimal(Animal, AnimalSet, float, IReadOnlyList<Species>). of the reference tick. OnBorn(Animal a) => Debug.Log($"{a} joins ({a.Origin})"); } Remarks Place a Species under the World, never inside another species (V-01). Everything under it is its configuration (ARCH-01): its SpeciesModule components (senses, actions, genes, stats, rules, diet, locomotion, body…). Within each kind, depth-first hierarchy order is the order: the n-th action found is action n, the n-th sense gives the n-th fragment of the situation text. The species owns its living animals (Animals): plain data records, in creation order (ARCH-03). §1, a stat module: public class Thirst : SpeciesModule { [SerializeField] float perTick = 0.5f, deadly = 100f; public StatId Value { get; private set; } public float PerTick => perTick; public float Deadly => deadly; public override void Declare(SpeciesBuilder b) => Value = b.DeclareStat("thirst", StatStart.Fixed(0f), 0f, deadly); public override void WritePromptRules(PromptWriter w) => w.Rule($"Thirst grows every step; an animal dies of thirst at {deadly}. Drinking resets it."); } Remarks Derive from it (or from a module kind: Sense, AnimalAction, Gene, DeathRule…) and place the component anywhere under a Species: it belongs to the nearest species above it (ARCH-05). Folders such as Senses or Life are only for order: within a kind, depth-first order is the module's order. A disabled component or an inactive GameObject is absent (ARCH-06). The World calls, in this order: Declare(SpeciesBuilder) on every module of the species, then Initialize() on every module, then WritePromptRules(PromptWriter) while the prompt is built, then Validate(ValidationReport); during the run, OnBorn(Animal) and OnDied(Animal, string). The stamina stat starts full and is capped by the animal's stamina.max trait. World's "Ground" GameObject with a Terrain on it or below it. Each cell is judged at its centre: at or below the water level it is water; steeper than the maximum it is blocked; otherwise walkable. Then tree footprints are blocked, and pockets cut off from the largest region are dropped. Water and steep cells are never walkable. The terrain must not change during a run: the grid is built once, in Initialize(). IsWater(Vector3) True when the point's cell lies at or below the water level. public override bool IsWater(Vector3 p) Parameters p Vector3 A world point. Returns bool True when the point is water; false by default. IReadOnlyList<string> Tokens { get; } Property Value IReadOnlyList<string> Methods Attachment(Animal, SenseContext) A new 64 × 64 byte array, standing for a camera image. public override object Attachment(Animal a, SenseContext s) Parameters a Animal The animal that decides. s SenseContext This tick's sense context. Returns object The attachment, or null for none (the default). Remarks Called by the ask-brains phase while it builds the query, only when HasAttachments is true. The attachment travels in Attachments; only a brain whose AcceptsAttachments is true may read it (V-51). AttachmentKey(object) "image" when GiveKey is set, else null (no key: the query is never memoised). public override string AttachmentKey(object attachment) Parameters attachment object An attachment this sense gave. Returns string The key, or null (the default): then a query carrying this attachment is never memoised, shared or cached. Read(Animal, SenseContext) Always "seen". public override int Read(Animal a, SenseContext s) Parameters a Animal The animal that decides. s SenseContext The world as it was at the start of the tick: nearest animals, food, cover, distances, rays. Returns int An index into Tokens. Remarks Called by the sense phase, through ReadAll(IReadOnlyList<Animal>, SenseContext, Span<int>), for every animal that decides this tick, and by tools (Observe(Animal, SenseContext)). It must give the same token for the same state, draw no random number, change nothing in the world, and learn about other animals only through s, which leaves out hidden and killed ones (SENSE-03, SENSE-06).

api/EvoSim.Testing.FakeHttpTransport.htm.summary: Class FakeHttpTransport Namespace EvoSim.Testing Assembly EvoSim.Testing.dll A fake server for HTTP brains and mutators (30 §2): answers each request with a scripted function, records every request, can fail, hang until the time-out, or answer late; counts requests in flight at once. public class FakeHttpTransport : IHttpTransport Inheritance object FakeHttpTransport Implements IHttpTransport Inherited Members object.Equals(object) object.Equals(object, object) object.GetHashCode() object.GetType() object.MemberwiseClone() object.ReferenceEquals(object, object) object.ToString() Examples A server that is down, and one that answers every chat with fixed points: var down = new FakeHttpTransport { FailWith = (path, body) => 503 }; var fake = new FakeHttpTransport(); fake.Respond = (method, path, body) => path == "/api/tags" ? new JObject { ["models"] = new JArray(new JObject { ["name"] = "gemma4:12b", ["digest"] = "0123456789abcdef0123" }) } : FakeHttpTransport.Chat("{\"eat\": 50, \"flee\": 30, \"hide\": 0, \"follow\": 10, \"rest\": 10, \"mate\": 0, \"hunt\": 60}"); var w = New(9).Lab1(prey: 10, predators: 2, randomBrain: false) .DefaultBrain<OllamaPointsBrain>(o => { o.Transport = fake; o.ConfigureClient("http://ollama.test", 5f, 3, 0f, 2); }).Build(); w.Advance(1); Assert.LessOrEqual(fake.MaxInFlight, 2, "the parallel cap"); Remarks Give it to an HTTP brain or mutator client through its Transport property, so tests never call a real server (30 §2). Jev(int) and OllamaPoints(int) make fakes that answer like the two reference servers, with deterministic numbers; For(HttpBrain) picks the right one for a brain. It may be called from several threads at once: Requests is filled under a lock. Fields DelayMs The delay before each answer, in milliseconds; 0 = none. public int DelayMs Field Value int FailWith An HTTP status to fail with for (path, body), thrown as an HttpFailure; 0 = answer normally. public Func<string, JObject, int> FailWith Field Value Func<string, JObject, int> Hang True for (path, body) of requests that never answer: they wait until the caller's time-out cancels them. public Func<string, JObject, bool> Hang Field Value Func<string, JObject, bool> Requests Every request received, in arrival order: method, path, body (null for a GET) and API key. public readonly List<(string Method, string Path, JObject Body, string ApiKey)> Requests Field Value List<(string Method, string Path, JObject Body, string ApiKey)> Respond The answer's JSON for (method, path, body); body is null for a GET. The default answers {}. public Func<string, string, JObject, JToken> Respond Field Value Func<string, string, JObject, JToken> Properties Count The number of requests received so far, read safely while requests are in flight. public int Count { get; } Property Value int MaxInFlight The most requests that were in flight at the same time (to check a client's parallel cap). public int MaxInFlight { get; } Property Value int Methods Chat(string) An Ollama chat answer whose message has the given content. public static JObject Chat(string content) Parameters content string The assistant's text, e.g. a JSON object of points. Returns JObject The answer's JSON. Completions(JObject, Func<string, int, double>) A vLLM completions answer: for each prompt of the request, the log-probabilities of its allowed token ids, from a function of (prompt, slot); 100 prompt tokens are counted per prompt. public static JObject Completions(JObject body, Func<string, int, double> logProbability) Parameters body JObject The request's body, with its prompt array and allowed_token_ids. logProbability Func<string, int, double> The log-probability of slot k (the k-th allowed id) for a prompt. Returns JObject The answer's JSON. FakeLogProbability(string, int) The fake JEV's log-probability of option slot k for a text: from a hash of both, a multiple of 0.25 between -2.25 and 0. public static double FakeLogProbability(string text, int k) Parameters text string The prompt text. k int The option slot (0 for A, 1 for B…). Returns double The same number for the same text and slot, so a test can compute the expected rows itself. For(HttpBrain) A fake server for a known HTTP brain: Jev(int) for a JevBrain, OllamaPoints(int) for an OllamaPointsBrain. public static FakeHttpTransport For(HttpBrain brain) Parameters brain HttpBrain The brain to answer. Returns FakeHttpTransport A new fake, or null for any other brain. Jev(int) A fake JEV server: /v1/completions gets log-probabilities from FakeLogProbability(string, int), any other path an empty model list. public static FakeHttpTransport Jev(int delayMs = 0) Parameters delayMs int The delay before each answer, in milliseconds. Returns FakeHttpTransport A new fake. OllamaPoints(int) A fake Ollama server in points mode: /api/chat answers 0 to 100 points for each action the request's JSON schema requires, a hash of the prompt and the action; any other path an empty model list. public static FakeHttpTransport OllamaPoints(int delayMs = 0) Parameters delayMs int The delay before each answer, in milliseconds. Returns FakeHttpTransport A new fake. Prompt(JObject) The user message of a chat request: the prompt the brain or mutator sent. public static string Prompt(JObject body) Parameters body JObject The request's body. Returns string The first message's content, or null when there is none. SendAsync(string, string, string, string, CancellationToken) Records the request, then hangs, waits, fails or answers as scripted by Hang, DelayMs, FailWith and Respond. public Task<string> SendAsync(string method, string url, string json, string apiKey, CancellationToken cancel) Parameters method string GET or POST. url string The full address: the host and the path. json string The request body, or null for a GET. apiKey string Sent as a bearer token when not empty; never logged (OUT-04). cancel CancellationToken Cancelled by the caller at its time-out; the caller doesn't rely on the transport honouring it. Returns Task<string> A task that gives the response body. Exceptions HttpFailure The server answered with an error status, with whether another try may succeed.

.Species("prey", s => { s.PreyBody().Action<MateAction>("mate", founders: new[] { "Mate often." }).LifeRules(100, 0).LlmMutation(1f); s.Get<Litter>().Configure(3, 3, 40f); }) .Build(); var sp = Returns WorldBuilder The same builder, to chain more calls. FakeMutation(WorldBuilder, Action<FakeMutator>) Adds a mutator service whose client is a FakeMutator: mutations are answered at once, by no model. public static WorldBuilder FakeMutation(this WorldBuilder b, Action<FakeMutator> configure = null) Parameters b WorldBuilder The world being built. configure Action<FakeMutator> Called at once with the fake, e.g. to script its Answer; null = it appends "quickly". Returns WorldBuilder The same builder, to chain more calls. Gene(SpeciesSetup, string, string, string) Sets the contrast pair of an action's gene: two extreme sentences used only to test brains (GENE-23), keeping its founders and neutral allele. public static SpeciesSetup Gene(this SpeciesSetup s, string action, string pro, string anti) Parameters s SpeciesSetup The species being set up. action string The action's name; its GameObject carries the gene. pro string The sentence that pushes toward the action ("Always eat, whatever happens."). anti string The sentence that pushes away from it ("Never eat unless starving."). Returns SpeciesSetup The same setup, to chain more calls. Lab1(WorldBuilder, int, int, float, ActOrder, bool, int, int, int) Adds the Lab 1 small world (S03): 48 × 48 m, 24 prey (cap 40, floor 10), 4 predators (cap 6, floor 3), the reference phases, LLM mutation answered by a fake mutator, and the random brain as the world's default. public static WorldBuilder Lab1(this WorldBuilder b, int prey = 24, int predators = 4, float size = 48, ActOrder order = ActOrder.SpeciesInTurn, bool randomBrain = true, int incubation = 0, int preyCap = 40, int predatorCap = 6) Parameters b WorldBuilder The world being built. prey int The prey founders. predators int The predator founders. size float The side of the square world, in meters. order ActOrder The act phase's order (ACT-30). randomBrain bool False: no default brain; the test adds its own with DefaultBrain<T>(Action<T>, string). incubation int The ticks eggs incubate; 0 = babies are born at once. preyCap int The prey's cap. predatorCap int The predators' cap. Returns WorldBuilder The same builder: call Build() to run it. LifeRules(SpeciesSetup, int, int, int) Adds the life rules of 11 with the reference values: litters of 2 to 4 babies of 40 energy, uniform crossover, incubation, a cap that migrates the excess and a floor that brings newcomers. public static SpeciesSetup LifeRules(this SpeciesSetup s, int cap, int floor, int incubation = 0) Parameters s SpeciesSetup The species being set up. cap int The most animals the species keeps (POP-01). floor int The fewest animals: below it newcomers arrive (POP-03); 0 = none. incubation int The ticks an egg incubates before it hatches; 0 = babies are born at once (REPRO-20). Returns SpeciesSetup The same setup, to chain more calls. PredatorActionSet(SpeciesSetup) Adds the predator's four actions in order (PredatorActions), with their genes (09 §3). public static SpeciesSetup PredatorActionSet(this SpeciesSetup s) Parameters s SpeciesSetup The species being set up. Returns SpeciesSetup The same setup, to chain more calls. PredatorBody(SpeciesSetup, string, float) Adds the reference predator's body: its prompt header, the search rule, kinematic locomotion (walk 1, run 2 m per tick), energy, stamina 30, metabolism, a diet that strikes the prey and scavenges its carcasses, digestion, the mating rule, starvation and old age. public static SpeciesSetup PredatorBody(this SpeciesSetup s, string preyName = "prey", float killChance = 0.5) Parameters s SpeciesSetup The species being set up. preyName string The species it hunts and whose carcasses it eats. killChance float The probability that a strike kills, 0 to 1 (reference 0.5). Returns SpeciesSetup The same setup, to chain more calls. PreyBody(SpeciesSetup, float, float) Adds the reference prey's body: edible by strike (60 energy, a carcass of 2 portions of 30), the search rule, kinematic locomotion (walk 1 m per tick), energy (max 100, start 60), stamina, metabolism, a diet of grass, the mating rule, starvation and old age (1 500 ticks). public static SpeciesSetup PreyBody(this SpeciesSetup s, float stamina = 60, float run = 1) Parameters s SpeciesSetup The species being set up. stamina float The maximum stamina, in meters (reference prey 60). run float The running speed, in meters per tick (reference prey 1). Returns SpeciesSetup The same setup, to chain more calls. PreySenses(SpeciesSetup) Adds the prey's seven senses in situation-text order (04 §5): energy and stamina levels, food, predator, cover, other animal (with readiness), age. public static SpeciesSetup PreySenses(this SpeciesSetup s) Parameters s SpeciesSetup The species being set up. Returns WorldBuilder The same builder, to chain more calls. api/EvoSim.Testing.Place.html.summary: Class Place Namespace EvoSim.Testing Assembly EvoSim.Testing.dll Puts animals, food items, cover and carcasses at exact positions in a built world (30 §2), so a test sets up the very situation it checks. Records no event. public static class Place Inheritance object Place Inherited Members object.Equals(object) object.Equals(object, object) object.GetHashCode() object.GetType() object.MemberwiseClone() object.ReferenceEquals(object, object) object.ToString() Examples var w = New().Ground<PondGround>(20, 20).Food(0f, 0f).Phase<ActPhase>() .Species("prey", s => s.PreyBody().Action<DrinkAction>("drink").Module<Thirst>()).Build(); var sp = w.FindSpecies("prey"); var a = Place.Animal(sp, Place.At(10f, 15f)); // 2 m from the pond's shore var thirst = sp.Module<Thirst>().Value; a[thirst] = 50f; a.Choose("drink"); w.Advance(3); Assert.AreEqual(0f, a[thirst], "drank"); Remarks Call it after Build(). Methods Animal(Species, Vector3, Genome, float, string, Action<Animal>) Creates an animal of a species at a point and adds it to the living animals: by default each gene has its pool's first founder allele. public static Animal Animal(Species s, Vector3 p, Genome genome = null, float heading = 0, string origin = "founder", Action<Animal> atCreation = null) Parameters s Species The species, from w.FindSpecies("prey"). p Vector3 Where the animal stands; its height is set from the ground. genome Genome The animal's genome; null = each gene's first founder allele. heading float The direction it faces, in degrees around the vertical axis (0 = +z, 90 = +x). origin string How it came into the world, as recorded on the animal ("founder", "birth", "immigrant"…). atCreation Action<Animal> Called after the genome sets the traits and before the stats start from them: change a trait here (ANIM-17). chooses to mate, whatever it senses: var w = New(name: "baby age").Ecology(40f, 0f, 0f, regrow: 0f, prey: s => s.LifeRules(40, 0)).ReferencePhases() .DefaultBrain<ScriptedBrain>(b => b.Policy = q => ScriptedBrain.Prefer(q.Species, "mate")).Build(); A policy that reads the situation (the scripted prey of R-01): flee a close threat, eat food in sight, mate with a near partner, else rest. static float[] PreyPolicy(DecisionQuery q) { if (q.Species.Id != "prey") return Brain.Uniform(q.Species.Actions.Count); string threat = ScriptedBrain.Token(q, "Predator"), food = ScriptedBrain.Token(q, "Food"); string kin = ScriptedBrain.Token(q, "Animal"); string action = threat == "adjacent" || threat == "close" ? "flee" : food != null && food != "none" ? "eat" : kin != null && kin.EndsWith(", ready") ? "mate" : "rest"; return ScriptedBrain.Prefer(q.Species, action, 0.02f); } var w = New(seed).Lab1(prey: 30, predators: 5, randomBrain: false) .DefaultBrain<ScriptedBrain>(x => x.Policy = PreyPolicy).Build(); Remarks For each query it answers, in this order: a failure when FailWhen gives a message; the row in Vectors for the query's species and observation key; the row Policy returns; a uniform row. Add it with DefaultBrain<T>(Action<T>, string) and keep a reference from the configure callback, or find it with w.GetComponentInChildren<ScriptedBrain>(). Every query it saw is in Seen. Fields ActionLimit The most actions a species may have with this brain (DEC-14); no limit by default. public int ActionLimit Field Value int BatchSizes The size of each batch received, in order. public readonly List<int> BatchSizes Field Value List<int> Batches The queries received so far, failed ones included (Calls), and the batches (Batches). public int Batches Field Value int BrainId The brain's id (part of memo and cache keys, DEC-30); give two scripted brains in one world different ids. public string BrainId Field Value string Calls The queries received so far, failed ones included (Calls), and the batches (Batches). public int Calls Field Value int DelayCalls Answers arrive this many Advance(int) calls late (T-SPACE-07); 0 = at once. public int DelayCalls Field Value int FailWhen A failure message for a query, or null to answer it (DEC-34, DEC-40). public Func<DecisionQuery, string> FailWhen Field Value Func<DecisionQuery, string> Instruction The answer instruction that ends the prompt (PROMPT-07). public string Instruction Field Value string MixesSpecies False: the brain can't mix species, so the World sends it one batch per species (DEC-13). public bool MixesSpecies Field Value bool Policy The row for a query, one probability per action of its species; returning null gives a uniform row. public Func<DecisionQuery, float[]> Policy Field Value Func<DecisionQuery, float[]> Seen Every query received, in order. public readonly List<DecisionQuery> Seen Field Value List<DecisionQuery> TakesAttachments True: queries may carry attachments, such as a camera sense's image (SENSE-41). public bool TakesAttachments Field Value bool TokenLimit The longest prompt it takes, in estimated tokens (DEC-14); 0 = no limit. public int TokenLimit Field Value int Vectors Fixed rows by "species id|observation key", used before Policy. public readonly Dictionary<string, float[]> Vectors Field Value Dictionary<string, float[]> Properties AcceptsAttachments True when queries may carry attachments (SENSE-41); false by default, and then V-51 rejects senses that give them. public override bool AcceptsAttachments { get; } Property Value bool AnswerInstruction The answer instruction that ends the prompt, hard-coded per brain because its parsing depends on it (PROMPT-07); empty for brains that read no prompt. public override string AnswerInstruction { get; } Property Value string CanMixSpecies True when one batch may hold queries of several species (DEC-13); false gives one batch per species. public override bool CanMixSpecies { get; } Property Value bool Id A short name of the brain and its settings ("random", "tinynet-8"): part of memo and cache keys, and the name of its answer cache file (DEC-30, DEC-33). Two brains that may answer differently need different ids. public override string Id { get; } Property Value string MaxActions The most actions a species may have with this brain (DEC-14, V-11); no limit by default. public override int MaxActions { get; } Property Value int MaxPromptTokens The longest prompt this brain takes, in estimated tokens (DEC-14, V-11); 0 = no prompt or no limit. public override int MaxPromptTokens { get; } Property Value int Methods Ask(IReadOnlyList<DecisionQuery>) Records the batch and answers each query from FailWhen, Vectors, Policy or a uniform row, at once or DelayCalls Advance calls later; each query counts as one model call. public override BrainAnswer Ask(IReadOnlyList<DecisionQuery> batch) Parameters batch IReadOnlyList<DecisionQuery> The queries the memo and the cache could not answer, at most one per memo key (DEC-32); never empty. Returns BrainAnswer One row or one failure per query, in query order: Now(float[][]) when every row is ready, or Later(int) filled from another thread, then completed. Remarks Called on the main thread by the ask-brains phase, once per tick and per batch. Read only the queries: a row must depend on the query alone (DEC-12), and the brain must not change the world (CORE-06). A query it can't answer is marked with Fail(int, string), never answered with a made-up row. Prefer(Species, string, float) A row that puts the weight on one action, by name, and epsilon on each other action. public static float[] Prefer(Species s, string action, float epsilon = 0) Parameters s Species The species, whose action order the row follows. action string The preferred action's name; an unknown name prefers the first action. epsilon float The probability of each other action; 0 = the preferred action always. Returns float[] A row of the species' length that sums to 1. Token(DecisionQuery, string) The token a query's observation has for one sense, to write a policy that reads the situation. public static string Token(DecisionQuery q, string label) Parameters q DecisionQuery The query. label string The sense's label, as in the situation text ("Food", "Predator", "Energy"…). Returns string The token ("none", "close", "low"…), or null when the species has no sense of that label.

api/EvoSim.Testing.SourceScan.html.summary: Class SourceScan Namespace EvoSim.Testing Assembly EvoSim.Testing.dll Reads the EvoSim source files for static checks (T-RAND-01, T-CORE-08, T-ACT-09): comments removed, line numbers kept. public static class SourceScan Inheritance object SourceScan Inherited Members object.Equals(object) object.Equals(object, object) object.GetHashCode() object.GetType() object.MemberwiseClone() object.ReferenceEquals(object, object) object.ToString() Examples T-ACT-09: no action reads gene values or allele texts. var files = new[] { "Runtime/Actions", "Runtime/Senses" }.SelectMany(SourceScan.Files); var hits = SourceScan.Find(files, @"\.Gene\b|Genome|Allele|FounderPool"); Assert.IsEmpty(hits, string.Join("\n", hits)); Remarks A static check reads code instead of running it: "no action reads a gene's text", "no UnityEngine.Random in the runtime". Comments are blanked so that a rule named in a comment is not a hit; strings are kept. Methods Code(string) The code of a file with its // and /* */ comments blanked out; strings and line breaks kept. public static string Code(string path) Parameters path string The file's full path. Returns string The code, with the same number of lines as the file. Files(string) The .cs files under Assets/EvoSim/<folder>, sub-folders included, in a fixed (ordinal) order. public static IEnumerable<string> Files(string folder) Parameters folder string A folder relative to Assets/EvoSim, e.g. "Runtime" or "Runtime/Actions". Returns IEnumerable<string> Full paths; none when the folder doesn't exist. Find(IEnumerable<string>, string) Every line of the files' comment-free code that matches a pattern. public static List<string> Find(IEnumerable<string> files, string pattern) Parameters files IEnumerable<string> The files to read, e.g. from Files(string). pattern string A .NET regular expression, matched line by line. Returns List<string> One "file:line: text" entry per matching line; empty when nothing matches. Literals(string) The string literals of a file's comment-free code, with line numbers (T-CORE-08 looks for species names). public static List<(int line, string text)> Literals(string path) Parameters path string The file's full path. Returns List<(int line, string text)> Each literal's line (from 1) and text, still escaped as in the source.
